challenge.method: Compared the annotated tag’s own SHA with its target commit and the commit in the detail-record URL. Compared the SPDX name, plain licenseText heading, identifier and deprecation field. Checked the exact cited host and path against the similar Joinup TXT URL, the mixed-edition landing page, PDF, OSI and EUR-Lex references, and inspected the link-check metadata for contrary evidence.
challenge.results: The tag target matches the detail-record commit. The Commission URL occurs in seeAlso and in crossRef at order 6. SPDX recorded match “N/A”, isValid false and isLive false for that URL on 2026-09-16. Those historical fields qualify any assertion about SPDX link validation. Citation is directly visible, and the fresh 2026-11-26 capture returned HTTP 200. The Joinup inline TXT has a different host, and EUR-Lex has its own crossRef with match “false”. None of these alternative references establishes equivalence with the inspected file.

limitations: The deprecation flag describes the identifier in SPDX 3.29.0. The Index’s active state separately describes an editorial decision. Neither establishes publisher currency, legal effect or a subsequent release.

Documentary correspondence covers the exact citation and edition. Byte or legal equivalence, legal interpretation, downstream grant, redistribution rights and project-file applicability remain outside this finding.

The generated text and the cited document share a source relationship. They supply no independent corroboration of legal terms. The earlier EUR-Lex run supplies no qualifying evidence, and EUPL 1.0 and 1.1 remain provisional.
reasoning: The generated SPDX License List 3.29.0 detail record has licenseId “EUPL-1.2”, name “European Union Public License 1.2” and isDeprecatedLicenseId false. Its licenseText begins “EUROPEAN UNION PUBLIC LICENCE v. 1.2”. Both seeAlso and crossRef contain the exact Commission URL reopened in this review. The spelling “License” and omission of “v.” belong to the SPDX name field. SCES §7 requires an external index reference to identify its owning source and exact release or record revision. The annotated SPDX tag supplies the release-to-commit link, and the generated record at that commit supplies the fields.
